# SunEditor

> SunEditor is a modular WYSIWYG HTML editor written in vanilla JavaScript. All 30+ plugins ship in one package and you enable only the ones you need. It has zero runtime dependencies and is MIT licensed — free for commercial use, with no cloud service, account or license key.

Key facts:

- License: MIT. Free for commercial products, SaaS and internal tools. Keep the copyright and license notice.
- Dependencies: none at runtime. KaTeX/MathJax (math) and CodeMirror (code view) are optional integrations.
- Package: `npm install suneditor` (or load from the jsDelivr CDN). TypeScript type definitions are included.
- Frameworks: works with vanilla JS, React, Vue, Angular, Svelte and Web Components through the core package.
- Output: standard HTML. Display saved content with `suneditor/css/contents` and the `sun-editor-editable` class.
- Included: tables (merge/split), image/video/audio/file upload, links, math, code blocks, Markdown view, drawing, templates, layouts, slash commands, block handles — 30+ plugins, 25+ language packs, RTL support.
- Uploads go to your own server endpoint (`image.uploadUrl` etc.); SunEditor does not send content to external services.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://suneditor.com/getting-started): install, framework examples (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Web Components, CDN), rendering saved HTML
- [Options](https://suneditor.com/options): reference for 200+ editor and plugin options
- [Docs/API](https://suneditor.com/docs-api): instance API, events and plugin interfaces
- [Plugin Guide](https://suneditor.com/plugin-guide): built-in plugins, plugin types and writing custom plugins
- [Deep Dive](https://suneditor.com/deep-dive): themes, upload configuration, events
- [Architecture Guide](https://suneditor.com/deep-dive/guide/architecture): internals
- [Troubleshooting](https://suneditor.com/troubleshooting): SSR, styles, plugin errors, React StrictMode, value updates, uploads
- [v2 → v3 Migration](https://suneditor.com/migration): option converter and breaking changes

## Try it

- [Playground](https://suneditor.com/playground): configure options and toolbar, share the configuration by URL, copy generated code for each framework, open in StackBlitz
- [Feature Demo](https://suneditor.com/feature-demo): individual features in isolation
